description.value: Clear Creek is one of four campgrounds within Cultus Lake Provincial Park, set among forested mountains beside a large warm freshwater lake prized for swimming and watersports; expect crowds in peak summer as this is one of the busiest park destinations in the Lower Mainland.

raw_osm.name: Clear Creek Campground
raw_osm.operator: Sea to Sky Park Services Ltd.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Clear Creek Campground exists as one of four campgrounds within Cultus Lake Provincial Park, with a dedicated map link ('Delta Grove and Clear Creek campground map [PDF]'). Reservations are confirmed by the prominent 'Book camping' link and 'Reservation policies' section covering frontcountry and group camping. Food nearby and laundry are positively supported by the website's explicit listing of restaurants and a laundromat in the adjacent Cultus Lake community.
concerns: The OSM website URL points to the parent Cultus Lake Park page rather than a Clear Creek-specific page; campground-level amenity details (showers, potable water, hiker/biker sites, etc.) could not be confirmed from the available content.
The OSM phone number belongs to the private operator Sea to Sky Park Services Ltd., not BC Parks directly; the number could not be corroborated from the website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Clear Creek is a legitimate, operational 82-site provincial campground with confirmed online reservations and nearby food and laundry amenities — a useful and well-established stop for touring cyclists in the Lower Mainland.

wow_evidence: one of the busiest park destinations in the Lower Mainland
